prior_findings.title: Direct OpenAPI adapter calls leaked PyYAML ConstructorError for hostile YAML tags
prior_findings.evidence: Fresh hostile YAML fixtures for python/object/apply, python/object/new, python/name, custom tags, and malformed YAML returned structured INVALID AdapterResult from direct OpenAPIAdapter paths and AdapterRegistry. No ConstructorError escaped.

new_findings.title: MCP malformed top-level auth field is silently ignored
new_findings.expected: A deterministic limitation or structured target-input warning for malformed auth declaration.
new_findings.actual: Result status VALID with no limitation or error; malformed auth is ignored.
new_findings.release_gate_impact: Non-blocking LOW. No exception leak and no unsafe execution; conformance visibility should improve before broader MCP auth claims.
new_findings.recommended_remediation: Emit MCP_INVALID_AUTH when auth/authorization/authentication is present but not an object.
